summary: Read the builtin RegExp ignoreCase accessor from stored ECMAScript flags.

target.notes: When property resolution is proven to the builtin accessor, return whether the original flag set contains i; the setter is undefined.

semantics.brand_check: RegExp internal OriginalFlags, except RegExp.prototype yields undefined when getter called directly

caveats: Own properties or prototype mutation can shadow/replace the builtin accessor; then generic property semantics are required.
